title: Vienna Rising Again
author: X. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Hazel Thornbury, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
